description: Call a route of the mock like an HTTP client would and return the status, the x-loutre-* headers and the body. The headers x-loutre-status, x-loutre-delay, x-loutre-count, x-loutre-message and x-loutre-seed are honoured; latency is not awaited, it is reported in delayMs. Writes (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) are persisted when persistent state is on. For a GraphQL mock, POST to its GraphQL path with the body { "query": "…", "variables": { … } }; mutations are persisted the same way.

accessKey.description: Access key (lk_…) of a private mock you do not own

body.description: JSON body for POST, PUT, PATCH

ownerToken.description: Owner token received at creation (not needed when the account is connected with an API token)

name: call_mock
